mission_02: Concatenate h_i and h_j using np.concatenate([h_i, h_j]) to form the joint feature vector
The attention score is e_ij = LeakyReLU(a^T @ concat) where a is a learnable weight vector of size 2 * hidden_dim
Apply softmax across all neighbors: alpha_ij = exp(e_ij) / sum(exp(e_ik)) for all k in neighbors of i
